Use a browser project with D3 7 installed. These module examples append an SVG to the page. Run one example at a time with a bundler; the plain playground does not include D3.

blocks.title: Give categories equal spaces

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `scaleBand` gives categories separate bands. Its bandwidth is the width available for each category.
`join` creates, updates and removes selected elements to match the bound data.

blocks.text: Three equal-width bars occupy the weekday bands with gaps.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Use a category value that exists in the domain. An unknown category has no assigned band position.
